style.copy: These settings are converted into a natural-language instruction for Ivy.
style.prompt.avoidSadness: Avoid exaggerated sadness, trembling, sobbing, or a crying delivery unless the text explicitly asks for it.
style.prompt.emotionIntensity.balanced: Use moderate emotional expression with natural variation.
style.prompt.emotionIntensity.expressive: Allow stronger emotional expression when the text supports it.
style.prompt.emotionIntensity.restrained: Keep emotional expression restrained and subtle.
style.prompt.energy.balanced: Use balanced vocal energy with a natural conversational lift.
style.prompt.energy.high: Use stronger vocal energy and clearer emphasis.
style.prompt.energy.soft: Keep the vocal energy soft and low-pressure.
style.prompt.expressiveness.controlled: Keep prosody controlled with limited melodrama.
style.prompt.expressiveness.dramatic: Allow broader pitch movement and more dramatic phrasing.
style.prompt.expressiveness.natural: Use natural prosodic variation and human-like emphasis.
style.prompt.mood.calm: Sound calm, relaxed, and emotionally steady.
style.prompt.mood.empathetic: Sound empathetic and caring while staying controlled.
style.prompt.mood.happy: Sound lightly happy and upbeat without becoming cartoonish.
style.prompt.mood.neutral: Keep the emotional tone neutral, composed, and matter-of-fact.
style.prompt.mood.sad: Sound gently sad and reflective without audible crying.
style.prompt.pace.faster: Use a slightly quicker pace while staying intelligible.
style.prompt.pace.slower: Use a slightly slower speaking pace with clear phrasing.
style.prompt.pace.steady: Maintain a steady, natural speaking pace.
style.prompt.preservePreset: Preserve the core identity of the selected preset speaker.
